aspect: Symptoms fall away fast when the threat genuinely ends
description: The continuous-traumatic-stress evidence is direct: once a resident leaves the affected area, symptoms subside dramatically. Safety, where it is real, is itself the most effective single intervention.
energy_note: The treatment is often a different postcode.

aspect: Nightmare-focused work has the best ratio of cost to effect
description: In the Better Learning Programme cohort, roughly half reported no nightmares after treatment and a further 47% reduced frequency - from a school-delivered intervention.
energy_note: Half of them simply stopped having them.

description: Bronchiolitis obliterans does not reverse. A retina does not regrow. Delayed keratopathy at 20 years is not preventable by therapy. Honest framing here protects the patient from believing they failed at recovering.
energy_note: Naming what will not get better is also care.

aspect: Post-traumatic growth is real and is not the point
description: Some survivors do report deepened relationships and changed priorities. Presenting that as the expected outcome converts it into another standard the person is failing to meet.
energy_note: Don't make them grow on schedule.
